maxillary_keypoint_topology.keypoint_spatial_matrix: The keypoints in the superior row are positioned dorsally to the primary vibrissae field, maintaining a near-parallel alignment with the horizontal labial margin with a vertical separation of approximately one spot-diameter.

rhinarium_pixel_ratio.melanin_saturation_percentage: Melanin-saturated pixels occupy approximately 95% of the visible rhinarium surface, presenting as a high-density dark-grey to black distribution with minimal pink/pale pixel visibility.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable textural irregularities and potential callousing on the dorsal rhinarium; distinct erythematous (reddish) staining present on the chin fur.
